name: What can go wrong with ceramic tile installation if the prep is bad?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with ceramic tile installation if the prep is bad?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are cracks, loose tiles, lippage, water intrusion, and grout problems caused by poor prep or rushed curing. In Denver-area homes, moisture and subfloor conditions deserve extra attention, especially in basements and bathrooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bad prep can lead to cracked, loose, uneven, or water-damaged tile. Moisture control and substrate stability are the main things to verify before work starts.
